mapper.sql: id, title, content, notice_type, publisher, publish_time, top_flag, status, view_count

where.if: AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR publisher LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice (title, content, notice_type, publisher, publish_time, top_flag, status, view_count) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, IFNULL(#{noticeType}, 'NOTIFY'), #{publisher}, IFNULL(#{publishTime}, NOW()), IFNULL(#{topFlag}, 0), IFNULL(#{status}, 1), IFNULL(#{viewCount}, 0))
mapper.update: UPDATE notice SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
